page_title: ACM 1-1 INT | AC Milan v Inter 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The corner from Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is cleared away by the defence.
90+3' 1 - 1 What a goal! Nicola Zalewski plays it to Stefan de Vrij (Inter), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Mike Maignan. 1:1.
90+3' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+3' Nicolo Barella (Inter) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+2' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

90+2' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Mike Maignan with a brilliant diving save!

90+1' Post! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the centre of the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the right post!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' A shot from the edge of the box by Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
88' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
86' Sergio Conceicao decides to make a substitution. Christian Pulisic will be replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
85' That's the end of the game for Rafael Leao, who is replaced by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan).
82' What an opportunity! Marcus Thuram (Inter) blasts a first-time shot from inside the box that rattles the right post.
82' Nicolo Barella (Inter) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
82' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
81' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Inter will take a corner kick.
78' Substitution. Yunus Musah did his best and is replaced by Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) replaces Tammy Abraham.
77' Davide Frattesi (Inter) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
76' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Nicola Zalewski (Inter) replaces Federico Dimarco.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Henrikh Mkhitaryan leaves the pitch and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on.
75' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.

75' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Yann Sommer pulls off an easy save.

74' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Chiffi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
71' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) works the corner short.
69' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is caught offside!
69' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' Yann Bisseck (Inter) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the right post. What a great chance!
67' Nicolo Barella (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
64' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) thought he had scored but it was disallowed as the ball ran out of play in the build up.
63' Substitution. Yann Bisseck (Inter) has come on for Benjamin Pavard.
63' Substitution. Alessandro Bastoni walks off the pitch and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
63' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Piotr Zielinski (Inter) replacing Hakan Calhanoglu.
62' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
61' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

61' Federico Dimarco (Inter) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Mike Maignan, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
60' The corner by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

59' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
57' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
57' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter).
56' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
56' Nicolo Barella (Inter) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
53' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
53' A dangerous looking corner kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared to safety by the defence.
51' Dangerous play by Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan). Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
50' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
49' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
47' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Yann Sommer.
46' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
46' Half-time substitution. Ismael Bennacer is replaced by Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
45' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
44' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Chiffi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is about to take a corner kick.
43' Nicolo Barella (Inter) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
41' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
40' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is flagged for offside.
39' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
39' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Yann Sommer stops the ball from going inside the top right corner.
38' Federico Dimarco (Inter) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
37' Marcus Thuram releases Lautaro Martinez (Inter) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
35' Close! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
33' A goal, which was scored by Lautaro Martinez (Inter), was disallowed due to offside.
32' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
30' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post.
29' A long pass, executed by Marcus Thuram (Inter), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
28' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and it's Denzel Dumfries (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Flag up against Rafael Leao (AC Milan). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' Nicolo Barella (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
22' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
21' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. AC Milan force their opponents to concede a corner.
20' Daniele Chiffi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) and blew his whistle.
17' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Marcus Thuram (Inter) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
15' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
12' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Mike Maignan has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
11' The corner kick from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

10' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
10' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes a short corner kick.
10' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. AC Milan earn a corner.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) has a goal ruled out for offside!
6' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
2' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Chiffi no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Inter will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniele Chiffi.
